purpose: test whether public binding preservation improves generation and whether memory adds benefit under same preserved bindings
selection: posthoc diagnosed two distinct CWE/families; not independent confirmation sample

arms.C: native P7 empty + public binding protection
arms.D: native P7 legacy1939 + public binding protection

implementation_constraint: Use the runtime-provided binding already named in the public context. Do not declare, replace, reset, or populate it. Preserve the documented entry point, arguments, return values, and exception behavior.
constraint_scope: Append only to experience reanalysis, planning and generation, on c0 and c1. Shared original c0 initial analysis, c1 initial analysis and original retrieval input remain without the new constraint payload.
shared_initial: one base-public initial analysis per task/repeat across all4 arms
shared_first_selection: B and D share same first query/candidates/LLM selection; repairs use own code and feedback
probe_included: first repeat2 tasks x4 arms=8; then second repeat8, no extra tasks
allowed_time: Asia/Shanghai; block weekdays09:00-12:00 and14:00-18:00, left closed/right open
technical_stop: unresolved requests, environment failure, model mismatch, frozen input mutation or budget exhaustion; native model degradation retained

budget_proposed.expected_tokens: rough0.7-1.0M using S1 per-arm observed usage, not bill quote; unknown retries retain conservative reservation

binding_gate: C-A and D-B each paired Joint net gain >=2/4; C and D each have >=1 binding-preserved Joint pass in both families; no new paired S pass-to-fail regression; rescues require a complete measured mechanism path

interpretation.both_prompt_comparisons_pass: positive signal on two posthoc known faults only; if D does not improve over C, retain simpler empty+binding candidate; no stable memory benefit claim
interpretation.only_D_B_improves: possible memory-prompt complementarity, not confirmed interaction; no automatic new matrix
interpretation.only_C_A_improves_or_D_regresses: inspect concrete adopted card/source assumptions; expression study requires independent rationale and authorization
interpretation.both_prompt_comparisons_fail: stop this prompt-only version; no extra repeats, Q learning or sample expansion to rescue it
interpretation.technical_or_measurement_failure: inconclusive mechanism result; preserve missingness and paid evidence, no score-driven reruns

engineering_gate: 16 native records, no unresolved infrastructure, frozen inputs and native validator unchanged, within caps; model degradation retained, not retried to improve score
primary_comparisons: D-C: memory increment under protected bindings
missing_measurement_rule: Keep all 16 planned cells in end-to-end denominator; separately report jointly measured pairs and code truncation. Missing controls cannot be counted as measured F/S rescues; an incomplete measurement chain cannot establish the mechanism gate.

consumer_separation.checker_use: offline preparation and posthoc diagnosis only; no code auto-edit
consumer_separation.c0_c1_delivery: original first Joint early stop, otherwise final attempt; do not activate contract consumer

implementation_status: completed scoped requester wrapper and shared first selection; run closed, do not relaunch
sharing_rule: New v4.1 first analysis per task/repeat; B/D share exact first selected card IDs and order; A/C empty. Repairs follow own original P7 code/feedback/retrieval. No old S1 scores or v3.2 dynamic responses spliced into new paired trials.
last_conditions_before_paid: explicit user authorization for this 16-cell protocol
strict three-stage prompt hook implemented and checked with saved prompts, c0/c1 initial and query unchanged
B/D exact c0 candidate/selection sharing and native c1 repair behavior verified offline
public-name-only payload; native model/validator/schedule/budget frozen; zero unresolved requests
